proposition.claim:
Projection classes in L(X)/SS(X) are equivalent to the biorthogonal basis under conditions alpha,beta,gamma; no infinite-dimensional range premise is stated.

Normalized 1-unconditional basis. Mutually annihilating nonzero norm-one projections. Condition beta follows exactly from disjoint coordinate supports. Every X_s is one-dimensional, so no Y has Y intersect X_s infinite-dimensional for all s; condition gamma is universally true over an empty class.

For every antichain B and every x, |f(x)| <= (sum_B |f_t(x)|^q)^(1/q).

U=ell_2 with coordinate blocking realizes Assumption 7.3 with theta_U=1 and p=q=2. Allowed two-child norming operation among 1024 admissible children. Initial parameter growth n1=m1^2; later growth bounds admit recursive extension. Nonempty legitimate antichain. Finitely supported input x=e2.
